beast.sight:woolback: We live on the wild sheep. They are horned, in heavy coats, and graze the grass and the open wood two to four together. By dusk they are off the open ground.
beast.kill:woolback: Meat, fat and a hide. Nothing in it boils down to lees, because it is an ordinary animal of this ground and no feeder.
beast.habit:woolback: Two to four graze together on open grass by day. A struck one runs. By dusk the herd has left the open.
beast.once:woolback: One was grazing between the doors of an empty village, beside the well. The flocks walk right up to the old houses.
beast.sight:gobblet: Brown ground birds as high as the knee, pale in the head, walk the woods, the grass and the wet ground by day. We take them for the meat and the feathers.
beast.kill:gobblet: A little meat and a handful of feathers. There was no lees in it, since a bird is no feeder.
beast.habit:gobblet: By day it is in the woods, on the grass and in wet country. It runs from anyone who strikes it.
beast.once:gobblet: Our first arrows from the workbench were fletched with its feathers. Most arrows take them.
beast.sight:burrowhog: In the cold woods, on the crags and out on the snow, the brown tusked boar roots by day. One carries more meat than anything else we hunt.
beast.kill:burrowhog: Meat in plenty and a thick hide. Nothing of it boiled down.
beast.habit:burrowhog: One to three root together in cold woods, on crags and in snow country while the sun is up. None is left in the open by dusk.
beast.once:burrowhog: At noon on Sānu one was rooting in the snow, and nothing else was out on the snow anywhere in sight. By day the boar has that country to itself.
beast.sight:dune_skipper: Out on the sand and the dry grass by day runs a long-eared hare the colour of the sand. The sand people live on it.
beast.kill:dune_skipper: A hide and a little meat, and no lees. It is an ordinary animal, and hard to catch.
beast.habit:dune_skipper: Only by day is it out, on the sand and the dry grass, and it is away at once when struck.
beast.once:dune_skipper: In daylight on Marudesha, while Maruhar still lived, the hares were the only thing on the sand. Nothing hostile shared it with them.
beast.sight:glimmerfin: Bright fish swim in the sea and the channels by night and by day. Nothing comes up in water, so no feeder is in it with them.
beast.kill:glimmerfin: Raw flesh and fine bones, and it pays nothing. No feeder takes a body in water, so whatever swims is an ordinary animal.
beast.habit:glimmerfin: Shoals of two to five keep together in any open water and turn as one.
beast.once:glimmerfin: A feeder that was after one of us came to the edge of the water and stopped there. The fish went on swimming round our legs.
beast.sight:gloomshade: Tama come up everywhere at night, and in the caves at all hours. They are dark and upright, the height of a person. Anything dead left on the ground brings them.
beast.kill:gloomshade: Bone, and a dark raw flesh that is the matter of other feeders it has eaten. One had a long bone in it of a kind no grazing animal here has.
beast.habit:gloomshade: Night brings it out over the whole living ground, and the caves have it at any hour. A lamp does not turn one that is already up, and it walks into the light. Full sun takes it apart.
beast.once:gloomshade: At midday one came out of the brood nest in a Broken Store and fell apart at the wall in the sun. The nest puts them out by day as well.
beast.sight:thornling: By day Kantak stand among the bushes and pass for them: waist-high bramble and sapling with a red bud on top. At night they walk.
beast.kill:thornling: Thorn and plant fibre. The green growth it eats is what it is made of, and that is what came out of it.
beast.habit:thornling: By day it stands still among the bushes until a body comes within fourteen strides of it. After dark it walks.
beast.once:thornling: One went down at our walls in a Night raid. Since Vanahar was killed, its packs come for the stores at dusk.
beast.sight:gelcap: Kinva sit in the grass by day, knee-high lumps of jelly under a red skin, and hop at anyone who comes near. Their jelly goes into the offering for Vanahar.
beast.kill:gelcap: Nothing under the skin but jelly: the rot out of fallen growth, which it formed in. It has no shape of its own inside.
beast.habit:gelcap: Until something disturbs it, it sits on one patch. When it moves, the tall grass where it sat is gone.
beast.once:gelcap: Our first Vanahar Likeness took two lumps of its jelly. Laid on the stone, the likeness brings Vanahar up for what is in it.
beast.sight:bog_lurker: Kaddam lie sunk to the head in the mud of Panka, by day as by night, and stand up when someone comes close. They are chest-high, reed and peat, with roots trailing.
beast.kill:bog_lurker: Reed fibre and peat, and the bones of whatever had died in the mud where it lay.
beast.habit:bog_lurker: On mud with nothing near it, it lies sunk with only the head showing. It comes up in mud and never in open water.
beast.once:bog_lurker: In Panka one dropped a Lees Lump: lees that had set hard in the mud. It swallows the mud it lies in and whatever has set there.
beast.sight:frost_stalker: Vaka are pale runners on four legs that hunt the snow, the pine woods and the peaks at night, one to three together. They see a person a long way off.
beast.kill:frost_stalker: Hide, and now and then a long tooth. The hide that came off it is the hide of what it had run down.
beast.habit:frost_stalker: Cold country is where it hunts, at night. From twenty-four strides it sees a body and comes straight in.
beast.once:frost_stalker: At midday on the snow of Hima one stood in full sun a little way off, unharmed. It must have taken its body on this ground's cold, under the sun.
beast.sight:cinder_wisp: Live coals hang in the air over the sand at night and throw embers. They come to warm ash, and the fires of the sand people have them overhead.
beast.kill:cinder_wisp: When it went out, a little Ember Dust fell where it had hung. There was no body round the coal. The dust burns twice as long as coal does.
beast.habit:cinder_wisp: From ten strides it throws embers, hanging in the air, and it comes no closer.
beast.once:cinder_wisp: Deep under the living ground, one hung beside molten rock in the middle of the day. The coal that comes up on the sand at night is down there whatever the hour.
beast.sight:stonegnawer: Under the ground, at every depth from the turf nearly to the floor, low six-legged crawlers go about plated in scale the colour of stone.
beast.kill:stonegnawer: Plates of Stone Scale and lumps of coal. It eats rock, and coal where it finds it, and the plates are the stone it has eaten.
beast.habit:stonegnawer: Nothing is commoner under the ground. It is met at every depth from the floor up to the turf.
beast.once:stonegnawer: We killed one beside the nest in a Sealed Store, where pieces of the dressed walls are missing in clean gaps. This kind breeds in the stores and has been at the stone.
beast.sight:cave_skitter: We meet them in packs in the caves: small dark crawlers on eight legs, quick on the rock.
beast.kill:cave_skitter: Fibre and nothing else: old cord, sacking, threads. Whatever fibre it found went into its body.
beast.habit:cave_skitter: Packs of two to four run on the cave rock, small and fast.
beast.once:cave_skitter: One died on Fungal Turf on the living ground, and inside it was all white thread, the kind fungus puts through rock. Where nobody has worked, that is what it takes its body from.
beast.sight:crag_bat: Dark bats hang in the caves, and at night they fly over the crags and the peaks. They roost, so a held hearth turns them as it turns anything that walks.
beast.kill:crag_bat: Feather and scraps of hide, from the birds and small animals it takes.
beast.habit:crag_bat: It hangs in the caves by day and by night, and flies over the high rock of Pabbat and Sānu after dark.
beast.once:crag_bat: Over Pabbat one came down out of the night sky and died in the open. It was the same animal we meet in the caves.
beast.sight:rustbound: It stands in the rooms of the sealed stores, rust-red plates on a grey frame, as tall as a big man, and throws bolts of rust.
beast.kill:rustbound: Rust lumps, iron bars and barbed arrows. Opened over the pot, it had no bone anywhere in it.
beast.habit:rustbound: One that came from a nest goes no more than ten strides from it. It throws its rust from twelve strides.
beast.once:rustbound: A Barbed Arrow came out of one in a Sealed Store. It had eaten the harness and arrows stored there. The born say it was posted there.
beast.sight:sporeling: Knee-high fungus caps, lit from inside, hop about everywhere in the hollow.
beast.kill:sporeling: Spore sacs, and sometimes the mushroom itself. It has no body of its own beyond the cap it forms in.
beast.habit:sporeling: Strike one, and every Kavak near enough to hear comes for the one who struck it.
beast.once:sporeling: In the hollow one left a Glowing Mushroom where it died. That is the cap it had formed in, lying on the ground.
beast.sight:mycelid_knight: Two strides of fungus stand up in the hollow, with a cap at the top, plates on the body and one limb grown out into an edge.
beast.kill:mycelid_knight: Spore sacs, bone and Antar ore. The plates on it were Antar it had taken up from the rock.
beast.habit:mycelid_knight: Seldom more than two go together. It is slow and hard to knock back.
beast.once:mycelid_knight: In a Vault of the hollow one went down beside the nest. They breed where the lees was stored.
beast.sight:umbral_moth: Dark fliers with broad wings, violet at the edges, keep to the air of the hollow and throw dust from a little way off.
beast.kill:umbral_moth: Moth Dust, and almost nothing under it. The dust that falls from the great caps is what its body was.
beast.habit:umbral_moth: It never lands. It throws dust from nine strides.
beast.once:umbral_moth: We tied its dust to our first Jīmūt Kite. The kite carries the dust up into the air, where the great flier feeds.
beast.sight:glowmaw: Lit along the back and the tail, a long-jawed runner on four legs comes at us fast across the hollow.
beast.kill:glowmaw: Hide and spore sacs. It eats the hopping caps, and the light along its back is what it has eaten.
beast.habit:glowmaw: In ones and twos it runs fast across the hollow, and the light on its back shows it coming.
beast.once:glowmaw: One dropped a lump of Tala Ore in the hollow. It had eaten something that had been at the lower rock, it seems.
beast.sight:rift_ray: It comes over the islands on broad blue scaled wings, with a long tail behind. The bat and the moth are the same make of flier, filled with other matter.
beast.kill:rift_ray: Vihanga Scale. It feeds on the undersides of the pale sheets that hang under the islands and on what falls from the rims.
beast.habit:rift_ray: Over the islands it is in the air at all hours, and it stoops on a body from above.
beast.once:rift_ray: On the islands one came at us from under the rim, far below where we stood. It rides under the rim and rises over it.
beast.sight:shardling: Splintered pale crystal, a person's height and twice as broad, stands among the spires of the islands and looks like one of them.
beast.kill:shardling: Shards, and now and then Patik Ore. The shards still cut, and they loosen whatever holds them.
beast.habit:shardling: Slow and very hard, it does not move until it has someone to go for.
beast.once:shardling: On the islands one dropped a piece of Patik Ore. The crystal kinds feed on the seams of that ore and carry bits of it in their bodies.
beast.sight:aether_wisp: Over the islands a bright crystal moves through the air by itself. Round it the outlines of things go soft, as over a hot stone, and it throws pieces of crystal.
beast.kill:aether_wisp: Crystal fell where it had hung, and nothing else. There was no body round it.
beast.habit:aether_wisp: At twelve strides it throws crystal, and it keeps that distance.
beast.once:aether_wisp: A Vihanga Scale fell from one on the islands. It had been feeding on a dead Vihanga.
beast.sight:moonspawn: The moon is hollow on the dark night, and these come down out of it: dark walkers taller than a Tama, with a pale violet light of their own.
beast.kill:moonspawn: Shade Flesh from what it had eaten, and Moon Slivers, which are bits of its own body: lees set hard and pale. The born say the slivers are pieces of the moon.
beast.habit:moonspawn: It never goes down before dawn. The sun undoes every one still standing.
beast.once:moonspawn: At sunrise one stood in the open and came apart. Its kind has never had to go down before a dawn, it seems.
beast.sight:lunar_howler: On the dark night and no other, dark fliers with pale wings come down with the walkers. Nothing in the air is quicker.
beast.kill:lunar_howler: Moon Slivers and little else, the same pale set lees as the walkers of the dark night.
beast.habit:lunar_howler: Only on the dark night is it in the air. Nothing we have met is faster.
beast.once:lunar_howler: Dawn found one still in the air, and the sun took it apart as it takes the walkers.
beast.sight:sproutling: Once Vanahar is half spent, small green walkers of sprout and sapling come up round the stone, knee-high.
beast.kill:sproutling: Nothing. They had fed on nothing yet, and the pot got nothing from them.
beast.habit:sproutling: When their strongest goes back down, they go with it.
beast.once:sproutling: At the Vanahar Altar the animal went back down with Paroha still on the floor, and they went with it.
beast.sight:dune_mite: When Maruhar thrashes, plated crawlers of grit on six legs, the colour of sand, come off its body.
beast.kill:dune_mite: Empty grit. They live between the burrower's plates and had eaten nothing of their own, so there was no lees.
beast.habit:dune_mite: They come off the burrower when it thrashes, and leave nothing behind when killed.
beast.once:dune_mite: Maruhar went back under the sand at its altar while Kīta were still on the floor. None of them was left on the sand afterwards.
beast.sight:ashen_raider: Sand people with blades march on peopls' houses at first light, grey with the ash of their own fires. They go for what is stored and go home at dusk.
beast.kill:ashen_raider: He carried a Mūda, a grey token broken from the glass under one of their fires, and now and then an iron bar. The lees on him had been taken on the way, for the fire.
beast.habit:ashen_raider: He fights with a blade, comes with the Sand March at dawn, and goes home at dusk.
beast.once:ashen_raider: A fighter of theirs fell at our walls during a Night raid. A few of his people now come in behind the dusk packs, to reach a store while the pack has us busy.
beast.sight:ashen_hexer: His people burn a kill where it lies, with a long iron whose head is a basket of pitch. On a march he throws that burning pitch at the peopls.
beast.kill:ashen_hexer: He carried Mūda, and the long iron with its basket head packed with pitch and Ember Dust.
beast.habit:ashen_hexer: Standing off, he throws burning pitch from thirteen strides and does not close.
beast.once:ashen_hexer: Among what one carried was a Crystal from one of our stores. A march takes what it finds for the fire, and crystal is lees to them.
beast.sight:siege_brute: Behind the rest of a march comes the biggest of them, in thick padding, with a beam for doors and chests.
beast.kill:siege_brute: He carried more Mūda than the rest of the march, and iron.
beast.habit:siege_brute: He is the biggest of the march, slow and hard to knock back.
beast.once:siege_brute: On a Sand March at our houses he came up only after half the march was already at the walls.
beast.sight:m_thornling: It formed on the bones of the Iron Totem as the food was opened under the hand: a small green lump with a thorn.
beast.kill:m_thornling: It struck its first feeder down as hard as iron would. The iron of the totem head is its whole body, and there was nothing else to open.
beast.habit:m_thornling: Whoever carries the bones it feeds on has it at their side, and it goes for other feeders, which are food to it.
beast.once:m_thornling: One of us went down at night with it out. The totem came through to the bed with the body, food and all, and the lump was gone from the ground.
beast.sight:m_wisp: A point of colour the shade of Hīrak formed on the Hīrak Totem once its bones were opened. It has no shape beyond the point.
beast.kill:m_wisp: What struck the feeder down was as hard as gem. Hīrak, the head of the totem, is what it took its body from.
beast.habit:m_wisp: On sufferance it keeps close to the bearer, as a weaker feeder keeps near a stronger, and goes for the feeders round it.
beast.once:m_wisp: In a cave under the living ground the way took its bearer to the bed, and the point of colour was gone with no trace left.
beast.sight:m_brazier: Beside the Jalit Totem an ember hangs in the air. It formed on the Shade Flesh bound to the carved bones, and its body is the Jalit of the head.
beast.kill:m_brazier: Its blows were as hard as Jalit, and the feeder went down under them. Nothing of the ember was left to boil.
beast.habit:m_brazier: Near the hand that carries its food it hangs in the air. Any feeder that comes close is food to it as well.
beast.once:m_brazier: On the sand at night the one carrying the Jalit Totem fell, and the ember went out at the same moment.
beast.sight:m_shade: What forms on the Antar Totem is a small dark flier. Its food is the Shade Flesh on the bones, and its body is the Antar of the head.
beast.kill:m_shade: In the hollow it took down a feeder by itself. Nobody had pointed it at anything.
beast.habit:m_shade: Its bearer drove the totem once, as the food was opened, and it takes that hand for a stronger animal whose food this is. It flies close and goes for feeders.
beast.once:m_shade: Its bearer went down under a pack in the hollow, and the flier was gone at once. Nothing binds it to anyone.
beast.sight:m_mycelid: On the Tala Totem a small lit fungus cap formed. Its look follows the metal of the head, as every one of these does.
beast.kill:m_mycelid: The feeder it killed lay on the ground like any other kill, with its own remains in it. Of the cap itself there was nothing to boil.
beast.habit:m_mycelid: A hand has one of these under it at a time. A Whistle or a worn piece lets it have a second. It goes for feeders.
beast.once:m_mycelid: When its bearer fell deep in the hollow, the little cap was gone at once.
beast.sight:m_zephyr: A small white flier came off the Ākās Totem. Under its look it is the same kind of animal as all the others that form on a totem.
beast.kill:m_zephyr: It brought a feeder down over the islands and was still beside the bearer afterwards. There is nothing in it but Ākās.
beast.habit:m_zephyr: Wherever the carried food goes, it goes, and it turns on other feeders when they come near.
beast.once:m_zephyr: On the islands one of us fell with it out. Whoever stood by saw the body go down and the flier go with it in the same moment.
beast.sight:m_shardling: Like a small one of the island kind, a lit splinter formed on the raw remains bound to the bones of the Patik Totem.
beast.kill:m_shardling: Hard as the Patik it took its body from, it killed a feeder and left nothing of its own.
beast.habit:m_shardling: Feeders round it are food, and it goes for them. It stays by the hand that carries its food, on sufferance.
beast.once:m_shardling: Among the spires its bearer dropped, and the splinter went with the bearer.
beast.sight:m_moon: Something dark on four legs, a hand high, with pale tines, formed on the Gahan Totem. Nothing closer than the metal is known to give it that look.
beast.kill:m_moon: It ran a feeder down and killed it. Its body is Gahan, the hardest metal we have, and nothing of it is left for a pot.
beast.habit:m_moon: At the bearer's heel it runs, and it goes for any feeder in reach. The food it stays for is the Shade Flesh on the bones.
beast.once:m_moon: On the dark night its bearer fell at our walls, and the little tined thing was gone with the fall.
beast.sight:m_cairn: Off the Cairn Lamp comes a point of yellow light. The head of that totem is a lamp from the housing of the Cairn, and the look follows it.
beast.kill:m_cairn: A feeder went down to it. Its body is the lamp of the totem head, and there is nothing in it to open.
beast.habit:m_cairn: Like the eight others that form on a totem, it stays by the hand that carries the bones and goes for feeders.
beast.once:m_cairn: Beside a Cairn its bearer was beaten to the end of their strength, and the yellow point was gone in the same breath.
eight.sight:b_colossus: Roots came up through the joints of the paving, and then the body: root, bark and moss, far larger than anything else in the wood. Its roots ran up the six oaks of the floor.
eight.kill:b_colossus: Root and wood all through, and worked iron bars, which nothing in a wood makes. The Vanahar Remains still move. They loosen made things, so a bench built round them joins two pieces into one.
eight.loss:b_colossus: Every hostile thing we met was harder to kill from the day it died. Some dusks later Tama and Kantak came up round our houses in twos and threes and went for the stores until dawn.
eight.habit:b_colossus: Each likeness laid since has brought up another the size of the first, from some wood nearby, it seems. It slams the ground round itself and charges, and once it is hurt it throws up roots.
eight.once:b_colossus: One of us stood behind an oak of the floor. It charged straight at the trunk, and the oak stood. Its roots run up those trees.
eight.said:b_colossus: The forebears set Vanahar over Vana when the stones were raised. Lees from it turns everything of the woods that walks, and that country comes back to us.
eight.intro:b_colossus: Roots push up between the paving stones.
eight.phase:b_colossus.1: It tears its roots up out of the paving.
eight.sight:b_maw: The sand in the bowl moved, and a long body of segments came up under one of us. It is made of grit and throws grit in fans. The only footing was the rim and the gilded platform.
eight.kill:b_maw: Grit through the length of it, and at the middle a mass of rock from beside the molten rock. Gold from the lures was in it. Woken by fire in a ring of Deep Rock, its remains loosen Jalit Ore.
eight.loss:b_maw: At dawn sand people grey with ash marched on our houses for the stores, and turned for home at dusk. Since the kill, other kinds come up on the sand of Marudesha at night.
eight.habit:b_maw: The lure is gone when it comes up, whether we kill it or not. It travels under whoever stands on the sand, comes up beneath them and throws grit in fans.
eight.once:b_maw: Kīta were on the floor of the bowl before Maruhar came up. They ran to the place where it would surface and were there first.
eight.said:b_maw: Maruhar was set over the waste, and the sand people lived under it. Its remains burn hot enough to melt Jalit Ore.
eight.intro:b_maw: The sand in the bowl begins to move.
eight.phase:b_maw.1: Up out of the sand, it thrashes, and grit pours off it.
eight.sight:b_warden: A pale upright body came up over the stone when the bell was set down, and it hung in the air. It threw slow pale lumps in fans and was somewhere else between throws.
eight.kill:b_warden: Pale set matter with Hīrak through it, and lumps of Hīrak. Set round with Black Glass, the Kankāl Remains make the gate to the hollow, where its kind took its body.
eight.loss:b_warden: On the first dark night after the kill, Chandasāvak and Ulūk came up over the whole country and the sky went violet. No pack came for the stores that night. At dawn the sun took apart every one still standing.
eight.habit:b_warden: A Night raid at our houses breaks off while one of these is up. It hangs, throws slow pale lumps in fans, rings and spirals, and changes place. Near the end Tama come in for it.
eight.once:b_warden: We killed it while the Tama that came in for it were still on the floor. They had come to eat it as it failed, and we were in the way.
eight.said:b_warden: Kankāl was set in the deep rock by the forebears to hold the dark night shut. The peopls broke that seal, and now the moon's young come down.
eight.intro:b_warden: The bell is rung, and something pale comes up over the stone.
eight.phase:b_warden.1: Turning in place, it throws pale lumps out in spirals.
eight.phase:b_warden.2: Its body is coming apart, and Tama close in on it.
eight.sight:b_sporemother: The smoke reached the roof, and the roof moved: a mass of cap and thread hanging from the dome by its own growth. Pieces of cap fell from it, and Kavak formed where they landed.
eight.kill:b_sporemother: Cap and thread, Antar bars from the smokers it had eaten, and the Guhamāt Remains. Bedded in Hollow Rock over a fire, they loosen Tala and Ākās Ore, and the ore never gets hot.
eight.loss:b_sporemother: Eight nights on, nothing new had come up near our houses, though everything was harder to kill from the kill on. Its host stayed round it for the cap it dropped. Now its packs may come up near our gate to the hollow.
eight.habit:b_sporemother: It drops cap on marked ground, and Kavak form where the pieces land. Near the end most of its growth tears from the roof and it swings. If the floor empties, it goes back the way it came.
eight.once:b_sporemother: A Kavak formed on the floor where a piece of its falling cap had landed. The pieces are raw remains, and the lowest feeders form on them.
eight.said:b_sporemother: Guhamāt is the mother in the Under, with its small ones round it, and the forebears set it there. Burn the smoker at its altar and it comes down off the roof.
eight.intro:b_sporemother: Smoke reaches the roof of the dome, and the roof moves.
eight.phase:b_sporemother.1: Its cap splits open, and the inside glows.
eight.phase:b_sporemother.2: Most of its growth tears from the roof, and it swings on the rest.
eight.sight:b_regent: Something pale and very large came down out of the high air over the kite and circled the floor without landing. It stooped on one of us at a time and threw bolts from its body.
eight.kill:b_regent: Pale stuff that weighs almost nothing, and Tala bars. A Jīmūt Remains stands up from the hand however it is held. Set in a frame of Tala bars, it makes the gate to the islands.
eight.loss:b_regent: By the eighth night Jatu were flying over every country we walked, where before they kept to the caves and the high rock. A held hearth still turns them, since they roost.
eight.habit:b_regent: Few lesser feeders come near the floor while it is up. It circles out of reach and stoops on one of us at a time, throws bolts in fans and rings, and drops pieces of itself on marked ground.
eight.once:b_regent: One of us held a Jīmūt Remains from an earlier kill when the kite went up. It stood straight up from the hand, and the animal came down out of the air above it. We take that to point at the islands overhead.
eight.said:b_regent: Jīmūt is the storm the forebears set over the open air, and no hearth's edge has ever stopped it. Fly the kite from its altar and it comes down.
eight.intro:b_regent: Something pale and large circles down over the kite.
eight.phase:b_regent.1: Pieces of its body fall on the floor.
eight.phase:b_regent.2: Now it screams and stoops lower over the floor.
eight.sight:b_luminarch: Crystal gathered over the stone and turned. In the middle hung a body of dense crystal with a ring of pieces turning round it, and its beam swung slowly after one of us.
eight.kill:b_luminarch: Dense crystal all through, with Ākās bars in it. Bedded in Island Rock over a fire, the Ratan Remains loosen Patik Ore. A Ratan Crystal came with it, the densest crystal we have handled.
eight.loss:b_luminarch: Its kinds stayed on the islands round it, where its crystal was. With it dead they have nothing to stay for, and our gate to the islands would be their way to us. So far we have seen only the harder killing.
eight.habit:b_luminarch: Every lens laid so far has brought up one the size of the first. It throws rays and a slow beam, as a staff throws with no hand to tire, and changes place. Near the end Sakal form on its loose pieces.
eight.once:b_luminarch: At its last change a Sakal formed on the floor where a piece of its body had fallen. The kind forms on its own loose remains.
eight.said:b_luminarch: Nobody of ours has seen Ratan. They said it is a jewel the forebears set far off, that the lens gathers the light, and that the light calls it up.
eight.intro:b_luminarch: Crystal gathers over the stone and begins to turn.
eight.phase:b_luminarch.1: The ring of crystal round it starts to turn.
eight.phase:b_luminarch.2: It stops holding its shape, and pieces come away.
eight.sight:b_hart: Hoofbeats out of the dark, then a body on four legs with tines, giving a pale violet light. It ran straight at one of us and slammed the ground. Chandasāvak came up behind it.
eight.kill:b_hart: Lees set hard and pale, and Patik bars. Bedded in Black Glass over a fire, the Kuranga Remains loosen Gahan Ore, the ore that lies on the floor. They give its kind's violet light.
eight.loss:b_hart: The next dark night the deep kind came up as before, with no strongest at its head now. Packs with nothing over them do not hold ground, so a Night raid may fall on a dark night from now on, it seems.
eight.habit:b_hart: Only after dark does it come to a mask laid on its stone. It charges, slams a wide ring of ground and throws blades of its own body, and from halfway on it is in one place and then another.
eight.once:b_hart: Our fight with it ran until dawn. When the sun came up it went back down. The sun undoes its kind.
eight.said:b_hart: On the dark night the moon is hollow, and Kuranga is the largest thing that comes down out of it. Wear the mask before its altar and it sees you.
eight.intro:b_hart: Hoofbeats come out of the dark toward the stone.
eight.phase:b_hart.1: Violet light runs along its tines.
eight.phase:b_hart.2: Between charges it is in one place and then another.
eight.sight:b_sovereign: Stone moved inside the cairn, and a stack of dressed stone rose out of the base and hung there, standing stones on top. It threw glowing stones and swept a beam across the floor.
eight.kill:b_sovereign: Dressed stone, the gems and lamps of the housing it had eaten, Gahan bars, and arms better than any other store holds. The Nihān Remains are the strongest raw remains anyone carries.
eight.loss:b_sovereign: Silahādak came up on the surface at night and came in with the dusk packs. The base under every Cairn we passed stood broken, with dark gaps in it.
eight.habit:b_sovereign: Through the base it comes up to every key laid on the Cairn. It throws glowing stones in fans and rings, swings a beam, and changes place. Near the end Chandasāvak fall in behind it.
eight.once:b_sovereign: After the kill, one of us stood on the base. Under the paving it is hollow, with clean gaps where the animal ate its way through.
eight.said:b_sovereign: When the great lees ran out, the forebears closed their first stone under the cairn, to save it for the day it could be lit. Nihān is the store they left.
eight.intro:b_sovereign: Stone grinds and shifts inside the cairn.
eight.phase:b_sovereign.1: The stack of stone parts, and its glowing middle shows.
eight.phase:b_sovereign.2: Everything it has eaten shows as it comes apart.
eight.line:altar_waits: Nothing lies on the stone. Its bait is {a} {item}.
eight.line:dawn_down: {name} goes back down as the sun comes up.
eight.line:fallen.sub: What was in it lies on the floor
eight.line:night_only: Kuranga comes up here only after dark.
eight.line:withdraws: {name} goes back the way it came.
